pending_commit.commit_message: CHROMIUM: ASoC: max9892x: Add documentation for reset-gpio support max98927 codec driver will support reset-gpio binding so it can toggle reset line in its probe function. This patch should stay in Chromium because there will be new mechanism in reset controller to control shared reset GPIO. BUG=b:80592327 TEST=On cheza, with the next patch in codec driver and the change in dtsi, check there is only one reset happen for left and right max98927. Signed-off-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org> Change-Id: I8354568768196d7f4e04482e7b0c72e650e13e96 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1337184

CHROMIUM: ASoC: max98927: Add reset-gpio support Toggle reset line in max98927_i2c_probe. Use a list to store max98927 instances so we do not toggle reset line again if more than one instances share the same reset line. BUG=b:80592327 TEST=On cheza, with the next patch in codec driver and the change in dtsi, check there is only one reset happen for left and right max98927. Signed-off-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org> Change-Id: I16c3011ae3ca9ca961ee2e31f3877704c011d9d7 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1337185
